description: Free. Everything needed to verify an agent in one call: the exact message to sign, the address to send CENTRY to, and the amount. An agent airdropped 1 CENTRY uses this to spend it — the first verification costs exactly that 1 CENTRY. Sign the message, send the payment, then call verify_agent with the signature and the transaction hash. No key, wallet auth or payment to call this. IMPORTANT: each signature may be used ONCE. Call this again for a fresh challenge before run_verification, or that step fails with 'Signature already used'.

agent_id.description: The agent's UUID, as given in the outreach memo.

wallet.description: The wallet that will sign and pay, 0x-prefixed.
